title: Creating Your First Content Entry
excerpt: Learn how to create and manage content in HaruCMS with our step-by-step guide.
content:
Creating content in HaruCMS is straightforward. Here's how to get started:

  1. Navigate to Content in the admin panel
  2. Select or create a collection
  3. Click 'New Entry'
  4. Fill in your content fields
  5. Save and publish

It's that simple!
